_meta.description: Authoritative blue-collar skills vocabulary. All entries lowercase. Used as a whitelist: a token is treated as a skill only if it (or one of its aliases) appears here.
_meta.match_rules: Word-boundary regex match against full text. Multi-word phrases match only as whole phrases. Aliases resolve to a canonical entry.

tools_equipment: hand tools and power tools usage
oil_gas_maritime: stcw a vi 3 advanced fire fighting
stcw a vi 4 first aid medical

aliases._meta: Variants → canonical entry. At scan time we look for both, but emit only the canonical so downstream scoring stays clean.
